entry.name: jit.rota
entry.description: Use the jit.rota object for quick 2-dimemsional scaling and rotation of matrices.

attributes.name: anchor_x
attributes.description: The horizontal anchor point for rotation (default = 0) The anchor point is horizontally offset in pixels from the upper left corner of the display.

attributes.name: anchor_y
attributes.description: The vertical anchor point for rotation (default = 0) The anchor point is vertically offset in pixels from the upper left corner of the display.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: boundmode
attributes.description: Boundary handling mode (default = 0 (ignore))0 = ignore: Values that exceed the limits are ignored.1 = clear: Values that exceed the limits are set to 0.2 = wrap: Values that exceed the limits are wrapped around to the opposite limit with a modulo operation. (256 wraps to 0, 257 wraps to 1, and -1 wraps to 255, -2 wraps to 254, etc.)3 = clip: Values are limited not to exceed min or max. (e.g. numbers greater than 255 are set to 255, and numbers less than 0 are set to 0.)4 = fold: Values that exceed the limits are folded back in the opposite direction. (256 is folded back to 254, 257 is folded back to 253, and -1 is folded back to 1, -2 to 2, etc.)
